_: One entry per photo in public/devices/. plate: the green-screen photo in plates/; frame: how the plate becomes the 1080x1350 picture (scale = resized to fit, pano = the 2160x1344 panorama covered into 2160x1350 then its left half, mirrored first when mirror is true; only the left of a panorama screen is in the picture, so its page is laid out for that part plus overscan); page and viewport: what goes on the screen, captured at the screen's own shape (viewport height comes from the screen's measured aspect).
